text:
maya: Quick heads-up — backfill run started for agg-hours (shard range 1200-1500). console progress bar is jumping, looks noisy.
sam: I noticed that too. root cause might be shard split retries emitting duplicate processed counts.
jules: can we add a "commit_count" or per-shard final checkpoint event so console can show stable completion instead of rows/sec?
maya: agree. commit_count lets us render completed shards / total shards. low effort to emit from replayer.
kevin: routing question — when console schedules a backfill, do we default to dedicated lanes or let it use standard pool with preemption? SLO tradeoffs.
sophia: dedicated lane protects latency for online traffic but it'll eat reserved quota. i'd prefer a UI toggle and a soft default to "standard with priority flag".
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: backfill-metrics-probe v1 -> staging at 15:04 UTC. :rocket:
sam: prototype idea: progress summarizer should try 3 strategies: 1) completed_shards/total_shards 2) processed_rows/expected_rows 3) EMA-based ETA when expected is unknown. fallback in that order.
maya: good. small config example for EMA estimator we can surface in console advanced options:
```json
{
  "estimator": "ema",
  "window_s": 300,
  "min_samples": 5
}
```
jules: UX nit — when estimator switches modes (e.g., from rows to ETA), show a little badge "estimator: ETA (auto)" and a tooltip explaining confidence. avoid surprise.
kevin: quotas: we should cap concurrent backfills per-org to 3 by default and allow overrides via support for enterprise tenants. otherwise small teams starve.
sophia: also add an alert rule: if ETA increases by >50% over a 10m window, surface a critical notify to oncall/backfill-owners. that helps catch runaway replays.
sam: i'll add telemetry events: `backfill.run.start`, `backfill.run.progress_sample`, `backfill.run.commit_shard`, `backfill.run.finish`. fields: run_id, shard_id, processed_rows, commit_count, active_workers.
maya: can you prototype the estimator + dashboard panel? we need a single-card panel that shows run ETA, mode, and recent throughput sparkline.
sam: on it — i'll open a tiny PR and attach a staging dashboard link.
jules: sgtm. i'll write the tooltip copy and the console copy for the UI toggle.
maya: thanks all. follow-ups: sam to PR estimator; jules to UX copy; kevin to draft quota override doc. will check progress tomorrow.
